title: Bubble Pop
description: Pop the bubbles before they escape the screen! Try to get as many points as possible.
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. Bubbles will appear and float upwards.
3. Click or tap on the bubbles to pop them.
4. Earn points for every bubble you pop.
5. Try to beat your high score before time runs out!

Tips:
- Keep an eye on fast bubbles.
- Clicking accurately gives higher points.
- Stay focused and have fun popping!
